::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 11th [1863]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/ Yonge 1863/6
:::

My dear [Miss Smith](people/person_263.qmd)

Here are two [chapters](other_books/otherbook_275.qmd) to make up for the having missed one out last time. I was obliged to do so, for I had the wrong proof with me when I was from home, and had to wait till I could get at the proof of the first.

I believe I told you of our change of house. Our direction now is Elderfield, Otterbourn, [sic] Winchester

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

---

**Note:** In envelope addressed to Miss Smith/ 8 Wellington Road/ Old Charlton/ SE and postmarked Winchester 11 September 1863 and London SE 12 September 1863.
